## Headline

February was the Lisbon month. Total spending reached $5,722.74 across sixty-eight entries, $1,505.06 of it travel, and the month closed about $501 short of deposits — the second deliberate dip of the winter after December.

## Key findings

The two travel charges posted the day Mira flew out: $802.45 to Air Canada and $702.61 to Airbnb for the week's apartment, both on the Tangerine card on the 6th. The eight days away read clearly in the ledger — between the 6th and the 14th there are no Toronto storefronts at all, just the subscription autopays and a string of euro-priced café tabs settling in odd cents: three Time Out Market evenings ($97.92 together), a Pastéis de Belém stop, and two coffees at A Brasileira in Chiado.

## Category deep dives

Dining finished at $587.32 across thirty entries once the Lisbon tabs and the reentry weekend are counted together — the 27th alone had Bar Sybanne and a Cibo Wine Bar client dinner back to back. Groceries dropped to $513.26 across nine runs, light for obvious reasons, with the post-landing Loblaws restock on the 15th at $88.46. Sports held its four-class rhythm at $134 even around the trip.

## Alerts

The sweep stayed at $100 for the second time this winter — Lisbon took the rest. With January's $400 between the two trip months, the TFSA pattern is bending but not broken.

## Easy notes

Rent posted at $2,150 on the 1st. Toronto Hydro eased to $101.14. Subscriptions unchanged at $55.72. The PRESTO reload paused while Mira was away and resumed on the 24th.

## Outlook

March looks like a baseline month from here: no flights booked, the freelance retainers steady, and the first patio weeks still a season away. One client trip to Niagara is pencilled in mid-month.
